mentions.name: hivemunk
mentions.description: This app provides hive management for beekeepers, built around a virtual hive model of mutable state — boxes, frames, components, queens, and colonies that can be rearranged to mirror the physical yard — with treatments, feedings, and inspections layered on top. It is adding voice-driven inspections where narrating observations frame by frame is run through a speech-to-text and LLM pipeline that extracts structured data and maps it to the hive model.
mentions.problem: A single hive inspection produces a lot of structured data, but there is nowhere useful to put it, and tapping through a mobile UI mid-inspection is impractical during a gloved, veiled, honey-and-propolis-covered activity.
mentions.audience: Beekeepers who need a place to record the structured data produced by hive inspections.
mentions.author: jordanarseno
